description:
The heroes who rushed to crush the minions of the mysterious Hwang Sect fell into a trap and were on the verge of annihilation... Shortly before their death, at the moment when they combined their energy for their latest trick, the world 23 years ago unfolded behind a flashing light. Doctor Jang Ho is trying to protect his family from the dangers of this world!
